health.name: Health Potion
health.desc: Single use. Instantly restores your health to full.

beer.name: Beer
beer.desc: Single use. For 5 minutes: +20 damage, -40% armor.

coffee.name: Coffee
coffee.desc: Single use. For 5 minutes: +20% attack speed, +20% movement speed, -50% total HP.

purple.name: Witch's Purple Potion
purple.desc: Brewed by the Black Marsh witch from four monster parts. Drink to permanently gain +20% Fire, Cold, Lightning and Poison resistance.

demonheart.name: Demon Heart
demonheart.label: Life Leech
demonheart.from: Hellhounds, demon lords and the Balrog (Shadow Keep and beyond)

demoneye.name: Demon Eye
demoneye.label: Crit Chance
demoneye.from: Imps, Cinderfiends and demon lords (Shadow Keep and beyond)

demonhorn.name: Demon Horn
demonhorn.label: Max HP
demonhorn.from: Brimstone Brutes, demon lords and the Balrog (Shadow Keep and beyond)

rottenflesh.name: Rotting Flesh
rottenflesh.label: Poison Resist
rottenflesh.from: Zombies, Giant Toads, Poison Walkers and Poison Plants

trollhide.name: Troll Hide
trollhide.label: Life Regen
trollhide.from: Cave Trolls, Mountain Trolls and Troll Elders

demonicstone.name: Demonic Stone
demonicstone.desc: +6% Life Leech, +8% Max HP. 8% chance on hit to heal 4% of your max HP.

predatorstone.name: Predator's Stone
predatorstone.desc: +10% Damage, +10% Armor Penetration. +25% damage to bleeding enemies.

venomstone.name: Venomous Stone
venomstone.desc: +20% Poison Resist, +8% Evasion. Your hits poison enemies.

stormstone.name: Stormbringer
stormstone.desc: +8% Attack Speed, +20% Lightning Resist. 10% chance on hit to chain lightning to 3 nearby enemies.

infernalstone.name: Infernal Heart
infernalstone.desc: +25% Fire Resist, +5% Max HP. A burning aura scorches nearby enemies.

juggstone.name: Juggernaut Stone
juggstone.desc: +10% Max HP, +0.5% Life Regen, +5% Damage Reduction.

reptilestone.name: Reptile Stone
reptilestone.desc: +25% Bleed Damage, +15% Cold Resist. Reflects damage back at enemies that hit you (Thorns).

windstone.name: Wind Stone
windstone.desc: +10% Move Speed, +5% Evasion. Dodge-rolling grants +20% damage for 3 seconds.

scavengerstone.name: Scavenger's Stone
scavengerstone.desc: Each kill restores 0.5% of your max Life and 0.5% of your max Mana / Rage / Stamina.

bonedust.name: Bone Dust
bonedust.label: of max Mana / Rage / Stamina on Kill

ectoplasm.name: Grave Ectoplasm
ectoplasm.label: of max Life on Kill
ectoplasm.from: Wraiths, Wraithlings, Shadow Ghouls, the Risen Dead and Vampires

brimstoneash.name: Brimstone Ash
brimstoneash.label: of enemy hit damage reflected (Thorns)
brimstoneash.from: Pit demons (grunts, brutes, archers and their lords)

tempestglass.name: Tempest Glass
tempestglass.label: Lightning Damage
tempestglass.from: Sand Snakes, Storm Snakes and Vultures

prismcinder.name: Prismatic Cinder
prismcinder.label: Max Mana / Rage / Stamina
prismcinder.from: Magma Golems, Magma Crawlers and Cinderfiends

wraithessence.name: Wraith Essence
wraithessence.label: Cold Damage
wraithessence.from: Wraiths, Shadow Ghouls and the Risen Dead

uqdefender.name: Undying Bastion
uqdefender.desc: +10% Max HP, +5% Damage Reduction. Last Stand: once every 90s a killing blow instead leaves you at 40% life, invulnerable for 3 seconds.

uqberserker.name: Heart of Wrath
uqberserker.desc: +30% Damage, +5% Life Leech. Fury Unbound: while below 40% life you deal +50% damage.

uqtemplar.name: Seal of Knighthood
uqtemplar.desc: +8% Max HP, +5% Block Chance. Knighthood: your Squires can wear a helm, armor, sword and shield. Manage them in the Knights tab of your inventory; every knight shares the same gear.

uqsurvivalist.name: Snare of Echoes
uqsurvivalist.desc: +8% Evasion, +8% Cooldown Reduction. Twin Snares: every trap you throw is echoed by a second trap of the same kind beside it.

uqmarksman.name: Phantom Quiver
uqmarksman.desc: +8% Crit Chance, +6% Attack Speed. Ghost Volley: every projectile you fire has a 50% chance to pierce through enemies.

uqhunter.name: Totem of the Great Bear
uqhunter.desc: +8% Max HP, +6% Damage. Pack Alpha: summons 1 additional Bear companion (requires Summon Bear).

uqdjinn.name: Eye of the Tempest
uqdjinn.desc: +30% Lightning Damage, +25% Lightning Resist. Stormcaller: Lightning Arc chains to 3 additional enemies.

uqelementalist.name: Crystalline Prism
uqelementalist.desc: +30% Cold Damage, +15% Cold Resist. Turns Ice Bolt into Frozen Orb.

uqcrater.name: Crown of the Crater King
uqcrater.desc: +8% Damage, +6% Max HP. Crater Stomp: every 8s your next attack stamps a T-Rex foot, crushing enemies in a wide circle for 150% weapon damage. Apex Hunger: each kill grants a stack (max 5, lasts 6s) of +4% attack speed and +3% damage.

uqpyre.name: Pyre Heart
uqpyre.desc: +30% Fire Damage, +15% Fire Resist. Pyre Heart: while Immolate burns, a Flame Vortex swirls around you.

uqnecromancer.name: Lich's Phylactery
uqnecromancer.desc: +8% Cooldown Reduction, +6% Max HP. Legion: Raise Dead raises 2 additional skeleton minions.

demoneye+demonheart+demonhorn.hint: Three gifts torn from the Pit's own spawn.

bearclaw+boartusk+wolfpelt.hint: The claw, the pelt and the horn of the hunt.

harpyfeather+spiderleg+stormclaw.hint: Feather, fang and thunder on the wing.

demonhorn+firewing+lavacarapace.hint: Shell and wing of the fire-things, bound by a damned horn.

armordonplate+buffalohide+trollhide.hint: Hide, hide and plate: whatever refuses to fall.

alligatortooth+scalehide+tortugashell.hint: Tooth and scale of those who lurk.

harpyfeather+raptorclaw+wolfpelt.hint: Swift on the wing, swift on the claw, swift on the paw.

banditdirk+bonedust+goblinear.hint: A bandit's blade, a goblin's trophy and the bones of the fallen: the spoils of every skirmish.

banditdirk+spiderleg+wolfpelt.hint: Light feet: a hound's pelt, a spider's leg and a thief's knife.

bearclaw+bonedust+trollhide.hint: The bear's claw, the troll's hide and the bone of what they killed: tougher than the road.

bonedust+goblinear+rottenflesh.hint: Rot, bone and a goblin's greed: take what the dead leave behind.

armordonplate+golemcore+trollhide.hint: Stone heart, iron plate and troll hide: the wall that will not fall.

boartusk+demonheart+hellhoundfang.hint: The fang of a hellhound, a demon's heart and a horn that never tires of charging.

harpyfeather+knightsigil+wolfpelt.hint: A knight's sigil, a feather of grace and the pelt of a loyal hound.

coilspring+snakeskin+spiderleg.hint: A clockwork spring, a spider's cunning and a serpent's patience.

demoneye+stormclaw+vultureeye.hint: Eyes that never miss, and a claw that strikes like lightning.

bearclaw+heartwood+raptorclaw.hint: The living heart of the forest, the great bear's claw and the raptor's hunger.

scalehide+stormclaw+tempestglass.hint: Glass from the heart of a storm, bound with thunder and scale.

lavacarapace+prismcinder+tortugashell.hint: Fire and frost, held together by a prism of cinders.

flameclaw+harpytalon+rextooth.hint: The king's tooth, the fire-raptor's claw and the queen's talon: whatever hunts from above, below, and the flame between.

firewing+hellhoundfang+lavacarapace.hint: The hound's burning fang, a bat's ember wing and a beetle's molten shell: a heart that feeds the pyre.

demoneye+rottenflesh+wraithessence.hint: The essence of the restless dead, rotted flesh and an eye that sees beyond the grave.
